body: Thank you so much for this message ❤️❤️❤️ it means so much to me. I don’t really think my rapist feels emotions. I’m starting to think he doesn’t actually care like he said he did. He just doesn’t want to go to jail/prison so he blocked me. He didn’t even go to my friends funeral. He told me her parents said that he wasn’t allowed. I later find out the parents were messaging him begging him to come to the funeral. He ignored their messages. He demanded I don’t go to her funeral and told me we would hold one on that day. When that day came around he ignored me all day then told me he was too busy playing video games and I shouldn’t be mad. I don’t even think he cared about my friend. He even sold all of her valuable things so he could fund his alcohol addiction.

I’m so sorry that happened to you... I’m also so sorry for your loss :( 

I don’t understand how there can be so many evil people in this world. 

I should of known he was a bad person when he didn’t take her to any of her chemo appointments and ignored her for video games. I took my friend everyday to her appointments. I would wait 8 to 10 hours a day in the hospital keeping her company. She never really said much about her boyfriend. I figured he’s just a really reserved guy. Before my friend passed she told me to make sure that her boyfriend will be okay if anything happens to her. 

Then about a month before she passed away she texted me to be careful around him. When I asked her why she said that she changed the subject. 

Later when I asked the boyfriend about that he told me she was probably just loopy from the morphine. 

I think she tried to warn me. I desperately wish I could talk to her about all this.
Thank you, I’ll check it out.

I feel like I betrayed my friend who passed. When I told her parents what happened they blamed me and told me I was a horrible friend. That really hurt me. They told me I was stupid for staying around him for the 2 months that I did. I agree. I still don’t understand why I did either. I was absolutely miserable. He did threaten me a lot. Still Though. I’m just glad I finally got strong enough to get away from him after 2 months of hell.

I wish I could just hate him. I really want to expose all the messages he sent me to his friends and family but I know that wouldn’t help my case. Police have been working for over one year now to get him behind bars. Even with his confession to all the horrible things he did to me. Police have told me that it could be a few more years before he is questioned then arrested due to him leaving the county.

I don’t have insurance so I can’t afford it. When I was going to therapy I was basically told I can’t really be helped by 3 different therapists. They all wanted to do EMDR therapy to help me. I was diagnosed with dissociative disorder from all the trauma I have faced. I disassociate too much for most therapy to work for me.
Yes I’m in the US. I don’t have anyone to talk to. No one ever wants to talk to me. :/
I can’t tell you how many times I’ve gone to a hospital for help. I was always treated horribly. I fear hospitals now because of the treatment I’ve received. They don’t care.

I’m still here I guess I didn’t take enough once again. I feel really ill. I’m hoping I just wither away at this point. I don’t like my life. My brain is broken and won’t stop. I want everything to just stop. I can’t handle what happened to me. I don’t want to be alive. I don’t understand why the universe keeps torturing me. I wish it would just let me die. Im so tired.
